notes: spec_copy is copied verbatim from the spec's copy section. Do not edit it here without a new spec version.
flow_copy is quoted verbatim from the use case flows (button and link text).
draft_copy was written for the build because the spec does not supply it. It needs product and legal review.
Voice labels, taglines, and sample replies come from voices/manifest.yaml and the voice files, not from this file. Only the confirmation after choosing a voice lives here.
UC-REG-06 (age) is not built, by product decision. age_question and age_under_18 stay in spec_copy only because it mirrors the spec verbatim. They are not shown.
trial_summary is the UC-REG-08 wording from the 2026-09-25 account spec. Because the text changed, everyone who agreed to the old wording is asked to acknowledge it again on next sign-in (UC-REG-13).
1.4.0 (2026-10-05): trial_checkbox says 'my first journey', matching trial_summary and Trello card 47. The trial terms acknowledgment is asked again once.
Outbound message text (email_*) is short and private. It never names the person who died, the circumstance, task details, or anything deleted (UC-CASE-19, UC-CASE-21).

spec_copy.privacy_terms_summary: Your privacy matters, especially right now. Cairn never uses your information, or information about the person who died, for marketing or advertising. We do not sell it or share it for ads. We use it only to help you with the steps in front of you. You can delete your account and your information at any time from Settings.
spec_copy.privacy_terms_checkbox: I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
spec_copy.trial_summary: Cairn is free for 28 days, and we will not ask for a card. Your 28 days begin when you start your first journey, so nothing counts down while you get settled. Once they begin, they keep counting even if you pause. After 28 days, a subscription is needed to keep adding and updating your tasks. If you do not subscribe, your account becomes read-only on day 29. Nothing is deleted and nothing is charged. You can always close, download, or delete your information for free. We will remind you in Cairn before your free time ends, and outside Cairn only in the way you choose when you start your journey.
spec_copy.trial_checkbox: I understand that 28 days after I start my first journey, I will need a subscription to keep using Cairn fully.
spec_copy.ai_notice: Before we begin, an important notice. Cairn is an artificial intelligence (AI) guide. It is not a human. It is not an attorney and cannot give legal advice. It is not a therapist, counselor, or medical professional. Cairn helps you organize the steps after a death and points you to official instructions, and it can make mistakes. Whenever your situation calls for an attorney, a therapist, or crisis support, Cairn will always tell you and point you to one. If you are in crisis, you can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
spec_copy.ai_notice_legal: This notice is provided consistent with the disclosure requirements of California Senate Bill 243 (2025), which requires that you be told clearly that you are interacting with an artificially generated assistant and not a human.
spec_copy.ai_checkbox: I understand Cairn is an AI guide, not a human, attorney, or therapist, and is not a substitute for professional advice.
spec_copy.decline_acknowledgment: That's okay. You can't use Cairn without agreeing, but you're not stuck.
